news.title: How Oracle turns days of work into minutes with ChatGPT and Codex
news.body: Across recruiting, engineering, and operations, Oracle turns specialist knowledge into fast, repeatable workflows with ChatGPT Work and Codex.

news.title: Pollo AI turns creative ideas into campaigns with OpenAI
news.body: With GPT-5.6, GPT-6 Astra, and GPT‑Image‑2.5, Pollo AI helps creators turn bold ideas into detailed images and cinematic video ads.

news.title: MIT 研究用机器学习提高数据中心资源利用率
news.body: 报道介绍 Christina Delimitrou 团队改进云系统、共享硬件调度和服务器架构，以提高现有设备的计算效率。方向是减少软件与资源利用中的浪费，不能据此推断数据中心扩张的总环境影响已被消除。
news.title_original: Using AI to mitigate the growing environmental threat of data centers
news.body_original: By rethinking how large cloud computing systems operate, Associate Professor Christina Delimitrou seeks to make data centers more energy efficient.

news.title: Disrupting AI-enabled “false front” operations
news.body: OpenAI disrupted two AI-enabled influence operations that used false-front journalists and a think tank to spread geopolitical messaging.

news.title: Google 研究：AI 提高工作质量未必同步提高独立技能
news.body: 一项对执业专利律师开展的三个月随机试验发现，持续使用 AI 可改善工作质量，但脱离工具后的判断能力变化取决于资历。资深律师表现改善，初级律师平均未见技能增益且结果分化；结论需限定于该研究人群与任务。
news.title_original: Does better work always mean better workers?

news.title: Liquid AI 发布面向边缘设备的开放 d1 决策模型
news.body: d1-3B 与实验性 d1-omni-600M 通过单次前向计算输出结构化决策，支持不同模态输入。团队报告文本任务与部分硬件延迟测试，但未发布视觉、音频决策基准，也未报告实验小模型的速度。
news.title_original: Multimodal open d1 decision models for the edge

news.title: MIT 探讨 AI 时代人文学习的价值
news.body: 报道介绍 Concourse 项目如何把经典阅读、辩论与科学工程教育结合，让学生讨论智能和人的意义。文章呈现教师的教育观点与课程实践，不是关于 AI 学习效果的对照实验。
news.title_original: Discovering the value of humanistic inquiry
news.body_original: Students in MIT’s Concourse program delve deeply into the human condition, debate challenging questions, and learn to develop judgment about issues that can’t be quantified.

news.title: Falcon-ASR 聚焦阿拉伯语和阿联酋方言语音识别
news.body: TII 发布 1.6B 参数语音识别模型，支持多种语言和逐词时间戳，并报告六个阿拉伯语测试集及内部方言测试。误字率比较依赖选定测试协议和榜单快照，实际录音条件仍需单独评估。

news.title: NVIDIA 分享 Nemotron 在信息学与数学奥赛任务中的专门化训练
news.body: 团队通过监督微调、强化学习和反馈推理，将 Nemotron 系列用于 IOI 编程与 IMO 证明任务，并报告金牌水平表现。IOI 测试是遵循竞赛约束的非官方评测，未进入正式排名；两类任务使用专门化系统，不能视为通用能力的统一证明。
news.title_original: One Model Family, Two Gold-Level Results: Fine-Tuning Nemotron for IOI and IMO

news.title: OpenAI 计划为青少年加入升学规划和更多学习工具
news.body: 公告介绍即将推出的 College Planner，用于组织申请要求、截止日期与助学金步骤，并扩展闪卡、测验和青少年反馈机制。首期升学体验面向美国部分高中阶段，使用量不能直接视为教育效果证据。
news.title_original: Helping teens learn, plan, and shape the future of AI
news.body_original: College Planner is coming to ChatGPT for Teens to help students manage college applications, alongside new flashcards, quizzes, and a teen AI council.

news.title: Radisson 将酒店查找与比较接入 ChatGPT
news.body: OpenAI 客户案例介绍 Radisson 与 Accenture 合作构建酒店插件，让用户在旅行规划中探索、比较和预订酒店。文章中的早期转化数据来自客户案例，不能当作所有酒店或渠道的普遍收益。
news.title_original: Radisson Hotel Group brings hotel discovery into ChatGPT
news.body_original: Radisson partnered with Accenture to build a ChatGPT plugin using OpenAI technology, helping travelers find, compare, and book hotels while planning their trips.

news.title: OpenAI 扩展 ChatGPT 中 GPT-6 与交互式界面能力
news.body: 官方公告介绍面向更多用户的 GPT-6，以及可生成视觉回答、学习演示和即时工具的 Intelligent UI。内容描述产品发布与应用场景，具体使用仍取决于账户可用性和任务中的实际验证。
news.title_original: GPT-6 and Intelligent UI for everyone
news.body_original: GPT‑6 is rolling out globally in ChatGPT with Intelligent UI, delivering faster responses with visuals and interactive experiences you can explore and use directly.

news.title: MIT 超算团队持续梳理 AI 加速器硬件演进
news.body: 林肯实验室超算中心介绍自 2018 年开展的 AI 计算调查，汇总商用加速器的峰值性能和功率。硬件比较涵盖不同架构，峰值指标不能直接替代具体工作负载的实际速度与能效。
news.title_original: Supercomputing researchers document evolution of AI hardware
news.body_original: An ongoing survey tracks the latest AI accelerator systems to keep hardware relevant for Lincoln Laboratory staff and sponsors.

news.title: Atlassian 与 OpenAI 扩大企业知识和智能体合作
news.body: 双方计划将模型能力与 Teamwork Graph 的项目、文档和决策上下文结合，支持 Rovo 及现有工作流程。公告也讨论更深入的 Jira 集成探索，访问仍受权限约束，规划功能不能都视为已经上线。
news.title_original: Atlassian and OpenAI expand partnership to turn enterprise knowledge into action
news.body_original: Atlassian and OpenAI are expanding their partnership to connect frontier models with enterprise knowledge and help teams plan, build, and deliver work.

news.title: Google 用地理空间基础模型探索公共卫生数据缺口
news.body: Google 介绍 Population Dynamics Foundation Model 的五个合作案例，将预训练地点表征作为现有流行病学流程的输入。目标是缓解报告滞后与数据稀疏，案例结果仍需在具体地区和健康任务中验证。
news.title_original: Unlocking Earth AI’s planetary geospatial foundation models for global public health

papers.title: 多组元材料中通用机器学习力场误差的来源
papers.body: arXiv:2610.09837v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Universal machine learning force-field generalization to multicomponent environments generated by compositional design remains insufficiently assessed. We construct a benchmark of 7,599 multicomponent configurations inspired by high-entropy design, elemental substitution and anion mixing. Eleven pretrained models are evaluated against density functional theory for energies, forces and stresses, with assessment extended to elastic, vibrational and adsorption-related properties. Force errors are analysed through training-reference coverage, local geometric heterogeneity, distance directionality and elemental response. Distances to training-refere
papers.summary: 预印本摘要：作者以 7599 个多组元构型比较 11 个预训练模型与 DFT 的能量、力和应力，分析训练覆盖、局部几何及元素响应。压缩侧误差更明显等观察提示需要细分环境验证，不能仅用训练距离解释全部误差。

We present an extended deep energy method for thermo-mechanical crack propagation in which the crack remains a sharp polyline.
